title: compareProfiles
body:
## compareProfiles

Compare compressed sizes for several format and level choices while proving exact restoration of every candidate.

Native binding: `bounded zstd profile compress/decode comparisons with measured wall time`. Output kind: `["file","text"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | Absolute local regular file to capture. Compression and comparison treat it as original bytes; restoration and frame inspection treat it as a compressed stream. Dictionary inspection treats it as exact dictionary bytes. Changing bytes at the same path invalidates reuse. In a workflow, a pinned adopted file or an explicitly selected directory-snapshot member can supply these bytes; changing its captured content is refused. | `{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}` | **required** |
| `profiles` | One to four distinctly named format-and-level choices. Every candidate is actually compressed and restored. Sizes and content are verified; recorded producer wall time cannot be authenticated by later verification. | `{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":4,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"format":{"type":"enum","values":["zstd","gzip","xz","lzma","lz4"],"default":"zstd"},"level":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":19,"default":3}}}}` | **required** |
